info.name: Stackiq API contract (Newman)
info.description: API-contract suite for the stackiq app: Organisatie / Contactpersoon / Component(module) / Moduleversie / Contract CRUD via the OpenRegister object API (register 11, ADR-022), the Aanbod + ArchiMate/AMEF export endpoints, and the Settings/cronjob endpoints. Self-contained and idempotent: setup seeds the objects it needs and teardown removes them. Authz tests use {{noAuthBase}} (127.0.0.1) for cookie isolation.

exec: // SLUG-RESOLUTION PREFLIGHT (GAP-2): the numeric OpenRegister register id that
// holds stackiq objects varies between environments (dev box = 11, a fresh
// CI boot re-imports the register by slug and gets a different id). The register is
// imported under the stable slug 'stackiq', so resolve the numeric id from the
// slug here and set {{register}}. The org/contact/module/contract/etc. schemas are
// addressed by their stable slugs (the OR object router resolves a slug against the
// register), so they survive a re-import too.
pm.test('stackiq register resolved by slug', () => pm.expect(reg, "register with slug 'stackiq' exists").to.be.an('object'));
if (reg) { pm.collectionVariables.set('register', String(reg.id)); console.log('Resolved register slug=stackiq -> id=' + reg.id); }
pm.test('mutation persisted', () => pm.expect(b.naam).to.eql('NEWMAN crud org EDIT'));

item.name: list organisaties NO AUTH (authz: OR reads are not auth-gated)

exec: // Cookie isolation: authed requests run against {{baseUrl}} (localhost) and
// set a host-scoped NC session cookie. Authz requests run against {{noAuthBase}}
// (127.0.0.1) so that cookie is never sent -> genuinely unauthenticated.
// OpenRegister object reads are intentionally not auth-gated (ADR-022 -
// authorization on catalog data is OR's responsibility, not stackiq's).
pm.test('OR returns the list anonymously (200)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

exec: // The 'standard' schema is now provisioned in the stackiq register
// (previously a documented gap that 404'd). Per the prior note, this is now
// flipped to the happy-path list contract: a 200 paginated envelope.
pm.test('200 - standaard schema lists via its slug', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: get aanbod NO AUTH (authz: PUBLIC endpoint, no org -> 200 empty)

exec: // Cookie isolation: authed requests run against {{baseUrl}} (localhost) and
// set a host-scoped NC session cookie. Authz requests run against {{noAuthBase}}
// (127.0.0.1) so that cookie is never sent -> genuinely unauthenticated.
// AanbodController::getAanbod is annotated @PublicPage (by design - the public
// catalog of offers). Unauthenticated it has no 'current organization' so it
// returns 200 with an empty result set rather than 401. Asserting the real
// contract honestly (it does NOT require auth).
pm.test('empty results without an org context', () => pm.expect(b.results).to.eql([]));
